info.longName: KraneShares Bosera MSCI China A 50 Connect Index ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in securities of the underlying index and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities, including depositary receipts. The underlying index reflects the large- and mid-cap Chinese renminbi (“RMB”)-denominated equity securities listed on the Shenzhen or Shanghai Stock Exchanges (“A-Shares”) that are accessible through the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect or Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect programs.
